prompt: The browser's default blue outlines on buttons, links and form fields look off-brand. Restyle them in src/styles.css so they match our green look everywhere, including when they are selected or being used: use the accent green var(--accent) instead of blue, buttons with 6px rounded corners, and form fields with a 1px var(--line) border that turns var(--accent) while the customer is typing in them. Keep it working in dark mode. Make reasonable assumptions where a detail is missing and finish the whole change without asking questions.
